note: P4326 (Pro 28:16) — a ruler lacking understanding is a cruel oppressor; one who hates unjust gain lives long.

dims.v: senseless cruelty — the ruler without understanding, a great oppressor
the lack of understanding in a ruler that makes him a cruel oppressor — folly in power turning to tyranny, senselessness that crushes those it governs
the hatred of unjust gain it is set against (266580)
set against the ruler who hates ill-gotten gain and endures

tebunah (understanding) — 'a ruler who LACKS understanding is a cruel oppressor'; folly in a ruler becomes cruelty. Without understanding, power oppresses; the senseless ruler grinds his people (cf 28:15).
incorruptibility — the ruler who spurns ill-gotten gain and lives long
the hating of unjust gain by a ruler who therefore prolongs his days — the incorruptibility that refuses to profit by wrong, the opposite of the cruel oppressor's greed
the senseless cruelty it is set against (266577)
set against the understanding-less ruler who oppresses
sane (hate) — 'but he who HATES unjust gain will prolong his days'; the ruler who spurns corruption endures. To hate ill-gotten gain is the mark of a ruler who lasts (cf 28:16a; 29:4).
